# PRD-HND-01

**Has every assessment the design handed over returned an outcome for this version that is not a failure?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | HND: Hand-overs |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `evidence.type`, `evidence.outcome`, `evidence.design_version`, `data.personal`, `drivers.obligations`, `profiles` |

## Why it matters

The architecture assessment does not judge controls, privacy impact, AI impact or conformity; it may not let a solution into production before the assessments that do have spoken.

## Rule

evidence has a security-assessment for this version; a privacy-impact-assessment when any data set has personal true; an ai-impact-assessment when profiles include ai-solution and an obligation requires one; a conformity-assessment when an obligation's classification requires one. Each has an outcome, and no outcome is failed.
